# OpenCode Commands and Skills

<!-- Generated by tools/sync-opencode.py from .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do not edit directly. -->

Every skill has a matching slash command. The command loads the skill and
passes `$ARGUMENTS` to it. `auto` says whether the model may discover the
skill without the command (OpenCode `opencode/autoinvoke`).

| Command | Skill ID | Arguments | Intended posture | Auto |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/adopt` | `adopt` | [focus: full \| gdds \| adrs \| stories \| infra] | read/write | yes |
| `/architecture-decision` | `architecture-decision` | [title \| retrofit <path> \| accept <ADR-id>] [--review full\|lean\|solo] | read/write | yes |
| `/architecture-review` | `architecture-review` | [focus: full \| coverage \| consistency \| engine \| rtm \| single-gdd path/to/gdd.md] | read/write | yes |
| `/art-bible` | `art-bible` | [--review full\|lean\|solo] | read/write | yes |
| `/asset-audit` | `asset-audit` | [category\|all] | read-only | yes |
| `/asset-spec` | `asset-spec` | [system:<name> \| level:<name> \| character:<name>] [--review full\|lean\|solo] | read/write | yes |
| `/balance-check` | `balance-check` | [system-name\|path-to-data-file] | read/write | yes |
| `/brainstorm` | `brainstorm` | [genre or theme hint, or 'open'] [--review full\|lean\|solo] | read/write | yes |
| `/bug-report` | `bug-report` | [description] \| analyze [path-to-file] \| verify [BUG-ID] \| close [BUG-ID] | read/write | yes |

The intended posture is advisory in OpenCode: permissions are enforced per
agent, not per skill. The safety plugin still blocks the critical write and
read cases. Run read-only workflows under a read-only agent if you need hard
enforcement.
